6  Toxicokinetics of Imidacloprid - Without TK BIS data

  • Show All Code
  • Hide All Code
  • View Source

What would have happened if we didn’t have the TK BIS data ?

6.1 Data importation

Code 
Levels_time_points <- c(as.character(seq(1,3,1)), "3b", as.character(seq(4,7,1)), "7b", as.character(seq(8,14,1)), "14b", as.character(seq(15,42,1)))

df_TK_IMD <- f_read_data_TK("IMD") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ na_if(.x, -1))) |> 
  filter(Experiment != "TKBIS")


df_TK_IMD <- df_TK_IMD |> 
  mutate(
    Time = t,
    CiEPX = C_worm_EPX,
    CiIMD = C_worm_IMD,
    Weight = Weight_nog,
    Time_point_f = as.factor(Time_point)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::select(Time, CiEPX, CiIMD, Weight, w, Molecule, ID, expo, Time_point_f, Nb_rep, Experiment) |> 
  mutate(
    CiEPX = na_if(CiEPX, -1),
    CiIMD = na_if(CiIMD, -1)
    )|> 
  mutate(
    Time_point_f = fct_relevel(Time_point_f, Levels_time_points)
  )

df_TK_IMD_mean <- df_TK_IMD |> 
  dplyr::select(-ID) |> 
  group_by(Time) |> 
  summarise(
    CiEPX = exp(mean(log(CiEPX[CiEPX > 0]), na.rm = TRUE)),
    CiIMD = exp(mean(log(CiIMD[CiIMD > 0]), na.rm = TRUE)),
    Weight = mean(Weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    w = mean(w, na.rm = TRUE),
    expo = mean(expo),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(Molecule = "IMD")

6.2 Modeling of the toxicokinetics

Names of models :

  • C1 : One compartment model.
  • C1P : One compartment model with exposure in Petri dishes via gut content.
  • C1N : One compartment model, no uptake and no elimination in Petri dishes.
  • C2 : Two-compartment model.
  • C2P : Two-compartment model with exposure in Petri dishes via gut content.
  • C2N : Two-compartment model, no uptake and no elimination in Petri dishes.

6.2.1 In files creation for MCMC

Creation of the MCSim .in files :

Code 
Molecule <- "IMD"

######## C1 #################################################################
path_mod_IMD_C1 <- here::here("mod/TK_IMD_C1_woBIS")
path_fig_C1 <- here::here("fig/TK_single/IMD_C1_woBIS/")

Nb_Iter <- 500000
seeds <- c(C1 = 3330, C2 = 2422, C3 = 1242)

text_priors <- "Distrib(kuIMD,     LogUniform,   0.0001, 100000); # min, max 
Distrib(keIMD,    LogUniform,   0.0001, 100000); # min, max

Distrib(a_growth,  TruncNormal,   0.005,   0.0010,    -0.5,    1); # mean, sd, min, max
Distrib (Vr_a_growth,  TruncNormal, 0.0015, 0.01, 0, 1);

Distrib(Sigma_W,     TruncNormal,  0.03, 0.01, 0.0001, 1);
Distrib(Sigma_CiIMD, TruncNormal,  3.0, 3.0,    1, 1000);"

text_likelihood <- "Likelihood(CiIMD,  LogNormal, Prediction(CiIMD),  Sigma_CiIMD);  # Calcul des vraisemblances (geometric mean, geometric standard deviation)
Likelihood(Weight, Normal,    Prediction(Weight), Sigma_W);      # Calcul des vraisemblances"

text_param_ind <- "Distrib(a_growth,  TruncNormal, a_growth,  Vr_a_growth, -1.0, 1);"

#f_In_tot(path_mod_IMD_C1, Molecule, text_priors, text_likelihood, text_param_ind, Nb_Iter, seeds)

######## C1P #################################################################

# ./mcsim.m_TK_IMD TK_IMD_C1.in

An example of how to run the models MCMC is given in the bash code block below. You need to be in the right folder to launch a given model.

Code 
pwd
cd ..
cd ..
cd mod/TK_IMD
pwd

makemcsim m_TK_IMD.model &
for j in $(seq 1 3); do
./mcsim.m_TK_IMD TK_IMD_C${j}.in
done
  • Input files must a name like “xxxxx_C1.in”
  • Output files must a name like “xxxxx_C1.out”

6.2.2 Get MCMC results

The first step is to retrieve the information of the MCMC simulation experiments.

Code 
######### C1 #########################################

MCMC_out_IMD_C1 <- f_MCSim_ind(path_mod_IMD_C1)

NC_C1 <- MCMC_out_IMD_C1$NC
Nb_param_C1 <- MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Nb_param
Nb_experiment_C1 <- MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Nb_experiment
Nb_iter_kept_C1 <- MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Nb_iter_kept
N_iter_setpoint_C1 <- MCMC_out_IMD_C1$N_iter_setpoint

Common parameters :

  • The number of chains used : 3
  • The number of experiments : 63
  • The number of last iterations used to describe the posterior distribution : 10^{4}
  • The number of last iterations used to create the tab_setpoint.out file : 333

C1 : Number of parameters = 6 C1P : Number of parameters = 7 C1N : Number of parameters = 6 C2 : Number of parameters = 7 C2P : Number of parameters = 8 C2N : Number of parameters = 7

6.2.3 Priors used for the model

  • C1
  • C1P
  • C1N
  • C2
  • C2P
  • C2N
Code 
colnames(MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Priors) <- c("Nom", "Distribution", "P1", "P2", "P3", "P4")

MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Priors |> datatable(
  options = list(
    dom = 't',
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(
      list(className = 'dt-left', targets = "_all")
      )
    ),
  class="hover"
  )
#MCMC_out_IMD$Priors
Code 
n_samples <- 1e6 # Simulation of the distribution

df_priors_dist_C1 <- MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Priors |> 
  dplyr::select(Nom, Distribution, P1, P2, P3, P4) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(samples = case_when(
    Distribution == "Uniform" ~ list(runif(n_samples, min = P1, max = P2)),
    Distribution == "Normal" ~ list(rnorm(n_samples, mean = P1, sd = P2)),
    Distribution == "LogUniform" ~ list(exp(runif(n_samples, min = log(P1), max = log(P2)))),
    Distribution == "TruncNormal" ~ list(rtruncnorm(n_samples, a = P3, b = P4, mean = P1, sd = P2))
  )) |> 
  unnest(samples) |> 
  filter(!(Nom %in% c("kuIMD", "keIMD") & samples > 0.05))

col_prior <- Nord_polar[4]
alpha_prior <- 0.5

p_priors <- ggplot() +
  facet_wrap(~Nom, scales = "free")+
  
  stat_halfeye(
    data = df_priors_dist_C1, 
    aes(
       x = samples
       ),
    alpha = alpha_prior,
    fill = col_prior,
    color = col_prior,
    normalize = "xy" 
    ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Priors distributions", 
    x = "Parameter value", 
    y = "Density"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_priors

#MCMC_out_IMD$Priors
Code 
n_samples <- 1e6 # Simulation of the distribution

df_priors_dist_C2P <- MCMC_out_IMD_C2P$Priors |> 
  dplyr::select(Nom, Distribution, P1, P2, P3, P4) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(samples = case_when(
    Distribution == "Uniform" ~ list(runif(n_samples, min = P1, max = P2)),
    Distribution == "Normal" ~ list(rnorm(n_samples, mean = P1, sd = P2)),
    Distribution == "LogUniform" ~ list(exp(runif(n_samples, min = log(P1), max = log(P2)))),
    Distribution == "TruncNormal" ~ list(rtruncnorm(n_samples, a = P3, b = P4, mean = P1, sd = P2))
  )) |> 
  unnest(samples) |> 
  filter(!(Nom %in% c("kuIMD", "keIMD") & samples > 0.05))

col_prior <- Nord_polar[4]
alpha_prior <- 0.5

p_priors <- ggplot() +
  facet_wrap(~Nom, scales = "free")+
  
  stat_halfeye(
    data = df_priors_dist_C2P, 
    aes(
       x = samples
       ),
    alpha = alpha_prior,
    fill = col_prior,
    color = col_prior,
    normalize = "xy" 
    ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Priors distributions", 
    x = "Parameter value", 
    y = "Density"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_priors

# Large format per chain
mcmc_list_C1 <- lapply(split(MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Chains, MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Chains$Chain), function(d) {
  wide <- d %>%
    dplyr::select(Iteration, Parameter, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Parameter, values_from = value) %>%
    arrange(Iteration)
  
  mcmc(as.matrix(wide[,-1]))
})

mcmc_list_C1 <- as.mcmc.list(mcmc_list_C1)
Code 
  par(mfrow=c(1,3))

  gelman.plot(mcmc_list_C1,
            bin.width = 10,      # Number of observations per segment,
            # first segment --> at least 50 iterations.
            max.bins = 50,       # Maximum number of bins, excluding the last one
            confidence = 0.95,   # Coverage probability of confidence interval.
            transform = FALSE,   # improve the normality of the distribution
            autoburnin=TRUE)     # Remove first half of sequence

  
  gelman <- gelman.diag(mcmc_list_C1, confidence = 0.95, transform=FALSE, autoburnin=TRUE, multivariate=TRUE)
  print(gelman)
Potential scale reduction factors:

               Point est. Upper C.I.
a_growth.1.             1       1.01
keIMD.1.                1       1.01
kuIMD.1.                1       1.01
Sigma_CiIMD.1.          1       1.00
Sigma_W.1.              1       1.01
Vr_a_growth.1.          1       1.01

Multivariate psrf

alpha_prior <- 0.5
alpha_post <- 0.5
col_prior <- Nord_snow[1]
col_post <- col_IMD

MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Chains_plot <- MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Chains |> 
  mutate(Nom = str_remove(Parameter, "\\.\\d+\\.$")) |> 
  filter(!(Nom == "kuIMD" & value > 10))

p_post <- ggplot() +
  
  # Priors
  stat_halfeye(
    data = df_priors_dist_C1,
    aes(
       x = samples,
       #y = ..scaled..
       ),
    alpha = alpha_prior,
    fill = col_prior,
    color = col_prior,
    normalize = "xy"
    ) +
  
  # Posterior
  stat_halfeye(
    data = subset(MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Chains_plot, Nom %in% L_parameters_C1),
    mapping = aes(
      x=value
    ),
    fill = col_post,
    color = col_post,
    alpha = alpha_post,
    normalize = "xy"
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~Nom, scales = "free")+
  labs(
    title = "Posterior and prior distributions", 
    x = "Parameter value", 
    y = "Density"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(
    title=element_markdown(face="bold")
  )

f_get_mode <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(x)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

####### C1 ##########################################################

MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Chains <- MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Chains |> 
  mutate(Nom = str_remove(Parameter, "\\.\\d+\\.$")) 

ku_samples_C1 <- MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Chains |> filter(Nom == "kuIMD")
ke_samples_C1 <- MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Chains |> filter(Nom == "keIMD")

BCF_samples_C1 <- ku_samples_C1$value / ke_samples_C1$value

BCF_mode_C1 <- f_get_mode(BCF_samples_C1)
BCF_CI_C1 <- quantile(BCF_samples_C1, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
BCF_CI_low_C1 <- as.numeric(BCF_CI_C1[1])
BCF_CI_up_C1 <- as.numeric(BCF_CI_C1[2])
BCF_min_C1 <- min(BCF_samples_C1)
BCF_max_C1 <- max(BCF_samples_C1)
BCF_mean_C1 <- mean(BCF_samples_C1)
BCF_sd_C1 <- sd(BCF_samples_C1)

BCF_C1 <- c(
  BCF_mode_C1, 
  BCF_CI_low_C1, BCF_CI_up_C1, 
  BCF_min_C1, BCF_max_C1, 
  BCF_mean_C1, BCF_sd_C1
  )

6.2.6 Comparison of observed vs. predicted data

Creation of the .in files that will enable the obtention of the prediction of the model for all of our data points :

Code 
######## C1 #########################################
l_param_name_C1 <- "kuIMD, keIMD, a_growth"
f_Setpoint_ind(path_mod_IMD_C1,Molecule, l_param_name_C1)

######## C1P #########################################

An example of how to run the simulations for the predicted-observed data is given in the bash code block below. You need to be in the right folder to launch a given model.

Code 
pwd
cd ..
cd ..
cd mod/TK_IMD
pwd

for j in $(seq 1 63); do
./mcsim.m_TK_IMD TK_IMD_Setpoint_ind_${j}.in
done
Code 
Nb_experiment <- Nb_experiment_C1

######### Observed data ######################################################

dObs_ind <- df_TK_IMD |> 
  mutate(
    ID = as.numeric(ID),
    Group_tmp = case_when(
      ID < 65 ~ "Uptake",
      (ID > 64 & ID <= 128) ~ "Elimination",
      ID > 128 ~ "Uptake bis"),
    Group = fct_relevel(Group_tmp, c("Uptake", "Elimination", "Uptake bis"))
    )

colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "Weight"] <- "Weight_obs"
colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "CiIMD"] <- "CiIMD_obs"
colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "t"] <- "Times"

col_exposure <- c(Nord_aurora[4], Nord_aurora[1], Nord_frost[2])

############ C1 ##############################################################

Sim.Res.ind_C1 <- lapply(1:Nb_experiment, function(j) {
  read_tsv(file.path(path_mod_IMD_C1, paste0("Setpoints_ind_", j, ".out"))) %>%
    mutate(sim = j)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

df_mod_ind_C1 <- NULL

for (i in 1:Nb_experiment){
  
  ID_i <- unique(dObs_ind$ID)[i]

  Sim.Res.ind_i  <- subset(Sim.Res.ind_C1, sim == i) |> 
    dplyr::select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x))))
  
  dObs_i <- subset(dObs_ind, ID == ID_i)
  
  Time_pred = dObs_i$Time # !!!
  
  Nom_Endpoints = c("Weight", "CiIMD")
  
  Nsortie = 2
  
  MPV = IC_min = IC_max = Endpoint = index = NULL
  
  for (j in 1:length(Nom_Endpoints)){
    
    index =grep(paste0("^",Nom_Endpoints[j],"_") , colnames(Sim.Res.ind_i), fixed=FALSE)

    
    Data_sim = as.matrix( Sim.Res.ind_i[ , index] )
    
    MPV    = c(  MPV,  as.numeric( Data_sim[nrow(Data_sim), ] ) )
    IC_min = c(IC_min,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.025, na.rm=TRUE) )
    IC_max = c(IC_max,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.975, na.rm=TRUE) ) 
    
    Endpoint = c(Endpoint, rep(Nom_Endpoints[j], ncol(Data_sim)))
  }
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- data.frame(
    predict.endpoint = MPV,
    Time    = rep(Time_pred, Nsortie),
    low     = IC_min,
    up      = IC_max,
    Endpt   = Endpoint
    )
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- df_mod_ind_i %>%
    mutate(ID=ID_i)

  df_mod_ind_C1 <- rbind(df_mod_ind_C1, df_mod_ind_i)
}

df_mod_Weight_ind_C1 <- subset(df_mod_ind_C1, Endpt == "Weight" & Time !=0)
df_mod_CiIMD_ind_C1 <- subset(df_mod_ind_C1, Endpt == "CiIMD" & Time !=0)

df_predobs_CiIMD_ind_C1 <- dObs_ind |> 
  filter(Time !=0) |>
  left_join(df_mod_CiIMD_ind_C1, suffix = c("_obs", "_pred")) |> 
  dplyr::select(-c(Weight_obs, CiEPX)) |> 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace(.x, .x == -1, NA))) |> 
  drop_na()

df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1 <- dObs_ind |> 
  filter(Time !=0) |>
  left_join(df_mod_Weight_ind_C1, suffix = c("_obs", "_pred"))|>
  dplyr::select(-c(CiIMD_obs, CiEPX)) |> 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace(.x, .x == -1, NA))) |> 
  drop_na()

    mapping=aes(x=x_1, y=y_1),

    )+

    mapping=aes(x=x2, y=y2),
    color = col_line2
    )+

    mapping=aes(x=x_2, y=y_2),
    color = col_line2
    )+
  
  geom_abline(
    slope=1, 
    intercept = 0, 
    color = col_line0,
    linewidth = 1
    )+
  geom_pointrange(
    mapping = aes(
      ymin = low,
      ymax = up
    ),
    alpha = 0.5,
    color = col_IMD
  )+
  xlim(
    xmin = 0.5,
    xmax = max(df_predobs_Weight_ind_C2$Weight_obs)

  labs(
    x = "Observed weight of earthworms (g)",
    y = "Predicted weight of earthworms (g)"
  )+
  theme_minimal()

df_residuals_CiIMD_C1 <- df_predobs_CiIMD_ind_C1 |> 
  mutate(
    Residual = predict.endpoint - CiIMD_obs,
    Ratio_Residual = predict.endpoint/CiIMD_obs
    ) |> 
  mutate(
    Time_point = as.numeric(gsub("([0-9]+).*", "\\1" , as.character(Time_point_f))),
    Group = factor(Group, c("Uptake", "Elimination", "Uptake bis")),
    Time_relative = case_when(
      Group == "Uptake" ~ Time_point,
      Group == "Uptake bis" ~ Time_point,
      Group == "Elimination" ~ Time_point - 21
    )
    )

p_residus <- ggplot(df_residuals_CiIMD_C1)+
  geom_point(
    aes(
      x = Time_point,
      y = Ratio_Residual,
      color = Group
    ),
    alpha=0.7
  )+
  labs(
    x = "Time point (days)",
    y = "Predicted/observed ratio"
  )+
  scale_color_manual(
    values = col_exposure_bis
    )+
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = unique(df_residuals_CiIMD_C1$Time_point)
  )+
  scale_y_log10()+
  theme_minimal()

p_residus

6.2.7 Full individual trajectories

Creation of the .in files that will enable the obtention of the prediction of the full \(C_i^{EPX}\) trajectories for each individual :

Code 
Time_min <- 0

Time_max <- 44
Time_step <- 0.25
Time_pred <- seq(Time_min, Time_max, Time_step)
print_times <- paste(Time_min, Time_max, Time_step, sep=", ")
Molecule <- "IMD"


f_Setpoint_ind_full(path_mod_IMD_C1, Molecule, print_times, l_param_name_C1)
f_Setpoint_ind_full(path_mod_IMD_C1P, Molecule, print_times, l_param_name_C1P)
f_Setpoint_ind_full(path_mod_IMD_C1N, Molecule, print_times, l_param_name_C1N)
f_Setpoint_ind_full(path_mod_IMD_C2, Molecule, print_times, l_param_name_C2)
f_Setpoint_ind_full(path_mod_IMD_C2P, Molecule, print_times, l_param_name_C2P)
f_Setpoint_ind_full(path_mod_IMD_C2N, Molecule, print_times, l_param_name_C2N)

dObs_ind <- df_TK_IMD |> 
  mutate(ID = as.numeric(ID))
colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "Weight"] <- "Weight_obs"
colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "CiIMD"] <- "CiIMD_obs"
colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "t"] <- "Times"

time_limits <- dObs_ind %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(time_cutoff = max(Time, na.rm = TRUE) + 5)

Time_points_Nb_rep <- dObs_ind |> 
  dplyr::select(ID, Time_point_f, Nb_rep)

y_segment <- 2000

df_phases <- dObs_ind |>
  arrange(ID, Time) |>
  group_by(ID) |>
  mutate(
    row = row_number(),
    t_start = Time,
    t_end = lead(Time),  
    segment = row,
    y = y_segment
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(t_end)) |>  
  dplyr::select(ID, segment, t_start, t_end, y, Experiment) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    Phase = case_when(
      (segment == 1 & ID < 65) ~ 1,
      (segment == 2 & ID < 65) ~ 3,
      (segment == 1 & ID > 64) ~ 1,
      (segment == 2 & ID > 64) ~ 2,
      (segment == 3 & ID > 64) ~ 3,
      (Experiment == "TKBIS" & segment == 1)~1,
      (Experiment == "TKBIS" & segment == 2)~3
    )
  )

An example of how to run the simulations for the individual trajectories is given in the bash code block below. You need to be in the right folder to launch a given model.

Code 
pwd
cd ..
cd ..
cd mod/TK_IMD
pwd

for j in $(seq 1 63); do
./mcsim.m_TK_IMD TK_IMD_Setpoint_ind_full_${j}.in
done
Code 
##| cache: false

#nb_rows_ind <- NC*N_iter_setpoint+1

############### C1 ###################################################
Sim.Res.ind.full_C1 <- lapply(1:Nb_experiment, function(j) {
  read_tsv(file.path(path_mod_IMD_C1, paste0("Setpoints_ind_full_", j, ".out"))) %>%
    mutate(sim = j)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

df_mod_ind_C1 <- NULL

for (i in 1:Nb_experiment){

  
  ID_i <- unique(dObs_ind$ID)[i]

  Sim.Res.ind.full_i  <- subset(Sim.Res.ind.full_C1, sim == i) |> 
    dplyr::select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x))))
  
  dObs_i <- subset(dObs_ind, ID == ID_i)
  
  Nom_Endpoints = c("Weight", "CiIMD", "C_exposure")
  
  Nsortie = length(Nom_Endpoints)
  
  MPV = IC_min = IC_max = Endpoint = index = NULL
  
  for (j in 1:length(Nom_Endpoints)){
    
    index =grep(paste0("^",Nom_Endpoints[j],"_") , colnames(Sim.Res.ind.full_i), fixed=FALSE)

    
    Data_sim = as.matrix( Sim.Res.ind.full_i[ , index] )
    
    MPV    = c(  MPV,  as.numeric( Data_sim[nrow(Data_sim), ] ) )
    IC_min = c(IC_min,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.025, na.rm=TRUE) )
    IC_max = c(IC_max,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.975, na.rm=TRUE) ) 
    
    Endpoint = c(Endpoint, rep(Nom_Endpoints[j], ncol(Data_sim)))
  }
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- data.frame(
    predict.endpoint = MPV,
    Time    = rep(Time_pred, Nsortie),
    low     = IC_min,
    up      = IC_max,
    Endpt   = Endpoint
    )
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- df_mod_ind_i %>%
    mutate(ID=ID_i)

  df_mod_ind_C1 <- rbind(df_mod_ind_C1, df_mod_ind_i)
}

df_mod_Weight_ind_C1<- subset(df_mod_ind_C1, Endpt == "Weight")
df_mod_CiIMD_ind_C1 <- subset(df_mod_ind_C1, Endpt == "CiIMD")
df_mod_CeIMD_ind_C1 <- subset(df_mod_ind_C1, Endpt == "C_exposure")

df_mod_CiIMD_ind_t_C1 <- df_mod_CiIMD_ind_C1 %>%
  left_join(time_limits, by = "ID") %>%
  filter(Time <= time_cutoff) %>%
  dplyr::select(-time_cutoff) |> 
  left_join(Time_points_Nb_rep, by="ID")

df_mod_Weight_ind_t_C1 <- df_mod_Weight_ind_C1 %>%

  df_mod_ind_C2N <- rbind(df_mod_ind_C2N, df_mod_ind_i)
}

df_mod_CeIMD_ind_C2N <- subset(df_mod_ind_C2N, Endpt == "C_exposure")

  mutate(
    No_rep = paste0("No ", Nb_rep),
    Time_point = as.numeric(gsub("([0-9]+).*", "\\1" , as.character(Time_point_f))),

alpha_point <- 0.5
col_exposure <- c(Nord_aurora[2], Nord_aurora[3], Nord_aurora[4])

p_CiIMD_traj <- ggplot()+
  
  geom_segment(
    data = df_phases_plot,
    aes(
      x = t_start,
      xend = t_end,
      y = y,
      yend = y,
      group = ID,
      color = factor(Phase)
    ),
    linewidth = 2,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +

  geom_line(
    data=df_mod_CiIMD_ind_t_plot_C1,
    aes(
      x=Time,
      y= low,
      group = ID
      ),
    linetype="dotted",
    color = col_IMD
    )+
  geom_line(
    data=df_mod_CiIMD_ind_t_plot_C1,
    aes(
      x=Time,
      y= up,
      group = ID
      ),
    linetype="dotted",
    color = col_IMD
    )+
  geom_line(
    data=df_mod_CiIMD_ind_t_plot_C1,
    aes(
      x=Time,
      y= predict.endpoint,
      group = ID
      ),
    color = col_IMD,
    lwd=1
    )+
  geom_ribbon(
    data=df_mod_CiIMD_ind_t_plot_C1,
    aes(
      x=Time,
      ymax= up,
      ymin= low,
      group = ID
      ),
    fill = col_IMD,
    alpha=0.1
    )+
  geom_point(
    data = dObs_ind_plot,
    aes(
      x = Time,
      y = CiIMD_obs
    ),
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.7,
    color = col_red
  )+
  # facet_wrap(
  #   ~ID,
  #   ncol=4,
  #   #scales = "free_x"
  #   )+
  facet_grid(
    vars(Time_point_days), vars(No_rep)#,
    )+
  scale_color_manual(
    values = col_exposure,
    label = c("Uptake", "Elimination", "Depuration"),
    name = "Phase"
    )+
  labs(
    x = "Time (days)",
    y = "CiIMD (ng/g)"
  )+
  #lims(y=c(0, 300))+
  theme_minimal()

6.2.8 Simulation of the toxicodynamic in earthworms throughout the exposition

The goal here is to recreate the concentration dynamic in the average earthworm during our exposition scheme but without the fasting phase that was required for chemical analysis and during which elimination was happening.

Code 
Time_min <- 0
Time_max <- 42
Time_step <- 0.25
Time_pred <- seq(Time_min, Time_max, Time_step)
print_times <- paste(Time_min, Time_max, Time_step, sep=", ")

############ C1 ##################################

Sim.Res_C1 <- as.data.frame(fread(here::here(path_mod_IMD_C1, "Setpoints.out"),sep="\t"))

  
  Nom_Endpoints =c("Weight_1", "CiIMD_1", "C_exposure_1")
  Nsortie = 3
  MPV = IC_min = IC_max = Endpoint = index = NULL

  for (i in 1:length(Nom_Endpoints)){
    
    index =grep(paste("^",Nom_Endpoints[i],"\\.", sep="") , colnames(Sim.Res_C1), fixed=FALSE )
    
    Data_sim = as.matrix( Sim.Res_C1[ , index] )
    
    MPV    = c(  MPV,  as.numeric( Data_sim[nrow(Data_sim), ] ) )
    IC_min = c(IC_min,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.025) )
    IC_max = c(IC_max,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.975) ) 
    
    Endpoint = c(Endpoint, rep(Nom_Endpoints[i], ncol(Data_sim)))

    }

  df_mod_C1 <- data.frame(
    predict.endpoint = MPV,
    Time    = c( rep(Time_pred, Nsortie)),
    low     = IC_min,
    up      = IC_max,
    Endpt   = Endpoint,
    Experiment = c(rep(rep("Experience 1", length(Time_pred)), Nsortie))
    )
  
df_mod_Weight_C1 <- subset(df_mod_C1, Endpt == "Weight_1")
df_mod_CiIMD_C1 <- subset(df_mod_C1, Endpt == "CiIMD_1")

6.3 Summary

Code 
format_summary <- function(summary_df, model_name) {
  
  summary_df %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rename(BCF = last_col()) |> 
    rownames_to_column("stat") %>%
    filter(stat %in% c("Result_mode", "2.5%", "97.5%")) %>%
    
    pivot_longer(-stat, names_to = "param", values_to = "value") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) %>%
    
    mutate(
      value = sprintf("%.3g [%.3g ; %.3g]", Result_mode, `2.5%`, `97.5%`),
      model = model_name
    ) %>%
    
    dplyr::select(model, param, value)
}

res_C1   <- format_summary(Summary_res_IMD_f_C1, "C1")
res_C1P  <- format_summary(Summary_res_IMD_f_C1P, "C1P")
res_C1N  <- format_summary(Summary_res_IMD_f_C1N, "C1N")
res_C2   <- format_summary(Summary_res_IMD_f_C2, "C2")
res_C2P  <- format_summary(Summary_res_IMD_f_C2P, "C2P")
res_C2N  <- format_summary(Summary_res_IMD_f_C2N, "C2N")

all_res <- bind_rows(res_C1, res_C1P, res_C1N,
                     res_C2, res_C2P, res_C2N)


round_fold <- 1

extra_metrics <- tibble(
  model = c("C1","C1P","C1N","C2","C2P","C2N"),
  LL   = c(round(LL_C1, round_fold), round(LL_C1P, round_fold), round(LL_C1N, round_fold), round(LL_C2, round_fold), round(LL_C2P, round_fold), round(LL_C2N, round_fold)),
  BIC  = c(round(BIC_C1, round_fold), round(BIC_C1P, round_fold), round(BIC_C1N, round_fold), round(BIC_C2, round_fold), round(BIC_C2P, round_fold), round(BIC_C2N, round_fold)),
  fold2 = c(round(CiIMD_count_fold2_C1, round_fold), round(CiIMD_count_fold2_C1P, round_fold), round(CiIMD_count_fold2_C1N, round_fold),
            round(CiIMD_count_fold2_C2, round_fold), round(CiIMD_count_fold2_C2P, round_fold), round(CiIMD_count_fold2_C2N, round_fold)),
  fold5 = c(round(CiIMD_count_fold5_C1, round_fold), round(CiIMD_count_fold5_C1P, round_fold), round(CiIMD_count_fold5_C1N, round_fold),
            round(CiIMD_count_fold5_C2, round_fold), round(CiIMD_count_fold5_C2P, round_fold), round(CiIMD_count_fold5_C2N, round_fold))
)

final_table <- all_res %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = param, values_from = value) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("\\.1\\.$", "", .)) |> 
  relocate(BCF, .after = last_col()) |> 
  left_join(extra_metrics, by = "model") %>%
  dplyr::select(model, everything())

final_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = model
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = -model
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(12),
    data_row.padding = px(4)
  )

# Toxicokinetics of Imidacloprid - Without TK BIS data {#sec-ModIMDBIS}

What would have happened if we didn't have the TK BIS data ?

## Data importation

```{r data, warning=F, message=F}

Levels_time_points <- c(as.character(seq(1,3,1)), "3b", as.character(seq(4,7,1)), "7b", as.character(seq(8,14,1)), "14b", as.character(seq(15,42,1)))

df_TK_IMD <- f_read_data_TK("IMD") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ na_if(.x, -1))) |> 
  filter(Experiment != "TKBIS")


df_TK_IMD <- df_TK_IMD |> 
  mutate(
    Time = t,
    CiEPX = C_worm_EPX,
    CiIMD = C_worm_IMD,
    Weight = Weight_nog,
    Time_point_f = as.factor(Time_point)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::select(Time, CiEPX, CiIMD, Weight, w, Molecule, ID, expo, Time_point_f, Nb_rep, Experiment) |> 
  mutate(
    CiEPX = na_if(CiEPX, -1),
    CiIMD = na_if(CiIMD, -1)
    )|> 
  mutate(
    Time_point_f = fct_relevel(Time_point_f, Levels_time_points)
  )

df_TK_IMD_mean <- df_TK_IMD |> 
  dplyr::select(-ID) |> 
  group_by(Time) |> 
  summarise(
    CiEPX = exp(mean(log(CiEPX[CiEPX > 0]), na.rm = TRUE)),
    CiIMD = exp(mean(log(CiIMD[CiIMD > 0]), na.rm = TRUE)),
    Weight = mean(Weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    w = mean(w, na.rm = TRUE),
    expo = mean(expo),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(Molecule = "IMD")

```

## Modeling of the toxicokinetics

Names of models :

-   C1 : One compartment model.
-   C1P : One compartment model with exposure in Petri dishes via gut content.
-   C1N : One compartment model, no uptake and no elimination in Petri dishes.
-   C2 : Two-compartment model.
-   C2P : Two-compartment model with exposure in Petri dishes via gut content.
-   C2N : Two-compartment model, no uptake and no elimination in Petri dishes.

### In files creation for MCMC

Creation of the MCSim `.in` files :

```{r increation, message=F, warning=F, execute=T}

Molecule <- "IMD"

######## C1 #################################################################
path_mod_IMD_C1 <- here::here("mod/TK_IMD_C1_woBIS")
path_fig_C1 <- here::here("fig/TK_single/IMD_C1_woBIS/")

Nb_Iter <- 500000
seeds <- c(C1 = 3330, C2 = 2422, C3 = 1242)

text_priors <- "Distrib(kuIMD,     LogUniform,   0.0001, 100000); # min, max 
Distrib(keIMD,    LogUniform,   0.0001, 100000); # min, max

Distrib(a_growth,  TruncNormal,   0.005,   0.0010,    -0.5,    1); # mean, sd, min, max
Distrib (Vr_a_growth,  TruncNormal, 0.0015, 0.01, 0, 1);

Distrib(Sigma_W,     TruncNormal,  0.03, 0.01, 0.0001, 1);
Distrib(Sigma_CiIMD, TruncNormal,  3.0, 3.0,    1, 1000);"

text_likelihood <- "Likelihood(CiIMD,  LogNormal, Prediction(CiIMD),  Sigma_CiIMD);  # Calcul des vraisemblances (geometric mean, geometric standard deviation)
Likelihood(Weight, Normal,    Prediction(Weight), Sigma_W);      # Calcul des vraisemblances"

text_param_ind <- "Distrib(a_growth,  TruncNormal, a_growth,  Vr_a_growth, -1.0, 1);"
```

An example of how to run the models MCMC is given in the bash code block below. You need to be in the right folder to launch a given model.

```{bash, eval=F, execute=F}
pwd
cd ..
cd ..
cd mod/TK_IMD
pwd

makemcsim m_TK_IMD.model &
for j in $(seq 1 3); do
./mcsim.m_TK_IMD TK_IMD_C${j}.in
done
```

-   Input files must a name like "xxxxx_C1.in"
-   Output files must a name like "xxxxx_C1.out"

### Get MCMC results

The first step is to retrieve the information of the MCMC simulation experiments.

```{r IMDreadMCMC, message=F, warning=F, results='hidden'}

######### C1 #########################################

MCMC_out_IMD_C1 <- f_MCSim_ind(path_mod_IMD_C1)

NC_C1 <- MCMC_out_IMD_C1$NC
Nb_param_C1 <- MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Nb_param
Nb_experiment_C1 <- MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Nb_experiment
Nb_iter_kept_C1 <- MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Nb_iter_kept
N_iter_setpoint_C1 <- MCMC_out_IMD_C1$N_iter_setpoint
L_parameters_C1 <- unique(MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Priors$Nom)

######### C1P #########################################

```

Common parameters :

-   The number of chains used : `r NC_C1`
-   The number of experiments : `r Nb_experiment_C1`
-   The number of last iterations used to describe the posterior distribution : `r Nb_iter_kept_C1`
-   The number of last iterations used to create the `tab_setpoint.out` file : `r N_iter_setpoint_C1`

C1 : Number of parameters = `r Nb_param_C1` C1P : Number of parameters = `r Nb_param_C1P` C1N : Number of parameters = `r Nb_param_C1N` C2 : Number of parameters = `r Nb_param_C2` C2P : Number of parameters = `r Nb_param_C2P` C2N : Number of parameters = `r Nb_param_C2N`

### Priors used for the model

::: panel-tabset
## C1

```{r IMDreadpriorsC1, message = F, warning = F}
#| tbl-cap: Priors used for the model
#| label: tbl-IMDPriorsC1

colnames(MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Priors) <- c("Nom", "Distribution", "P1", "P2", "P3", "P4")

MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Priors |> datatable(
  options = list(
    dom = 't',
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(
      list(className = 'dt-left', targets = "_all")
      )
    ),
  class="hover"
  )

#MCMC_out_IMD$Priors
```

```{r IMDpriorsC1, message=F, warning=F}
#| fig-cap: Distributions of the priors.
#| label: fig-IMDpriorC1
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 8

n_samples <- 1e6 # Simulation of the distribution

df_priors_dist_C1 <- MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Priors |> 
  dplyr::select(Nom, Distribution, P1, P2, P3, P4) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(samples = case_when(
    Distribution == "Uniform" ~ list(runif(n_samples, min = P1, max = P2)),
    Distribution == "Normal" ~ list(rnorm(n_samples, mean = P1, sd = P2)),
    Distribution == "LogUniform" ~ list(exp(runif(n_samples, min = log(P1), max = log(P2)))),
    Distribution == "TruncNormal" ~ list(rtruncnorm(n_samples, a = P3, b = P4, mean = P1, sd = P2))
  )) |> 
  unnest(samples) |> 
  filter(!(Nom %in% c("kuIMD", "keIMD") & samples > 0.05))

col_prior <- Nord_polar[4]
alpha_prior <- 0.5

p_priors <- ggplot() +
  facet_wrap(~Nom, scales = "free")+
  
  stat_halfeye(
    data = df_priors_dist_C1, 
    aes(
       x = samples
       ),
    alpha = alpha_prior,
    fill = col_prior,
    color = col_prior,
    normalize = "xy" 
    ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Priors distributions", 
    x = "Parameter value", 
    y = "Density"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_priors 

```

```{r savepriorsC1, include = F}
ggsave(
  filename="TK_IMD_priors.png", 
  plot=p_priors, 
  width=8, height = 6, 
  path=path_fig_C1
  )
ggsave(
  filename="TK_IMD_priors.svg", 
  plot=p_priors, 
  width=8, height = 6, 
  path=path_fig_C1
  )
```

### Chains

::: panel-tabset
## C1

```{r IMDChainsC1, message=F, warning=F}
#| fig-cap: Parameters chains. Only the first iteration and the last `r Nb_iter_kept` are represented.
#| label: fig-IMDchainsC1
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 8

p_chains <-  
  ggplot(
    data = MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Chains |> filter(Iteration !=1), 
    aes(
      x = Iteration, 
      y = value, 
      color = as.factor(Chain), 
      group = as.factor(Chain)
      )
  )+
  geom_line(alpha=0.7)+
  scale_y_log10()+
  facet_wrap(~Parameter, scales = "free", ncol = 2)+
  
  scale_color_manual(name = "Chains", values = nord(palette = "frost"))+
  
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    legend.position = "right", 
    title=element_text(size=12, face="plain"), 
    axis.title.x = element_text(face="plain"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill="white")
    )

p_chains
  
```

```{r savechainsC1, include = F}
ggsave(
  filename="TK_IMD_chains.png", 
  plot=p_chains, 
  width=8, height = 5, 
  path=path_fig_C1
  )
ggsave(
  filename="TK_IMD_chains.svg", 
  plot=p_chains, 
  width=8, height = 5, 
  path=path_fig_C1
  )
```

## C1

```{r mcmclistC1, message=F, warning=F}
# Large format per chain
mcmc_list_C1 <- lapply(split(MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Chains, MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Chains$Chain), function(d) {
  wide <- d %>%
    dplyr::select(Iteration, Parameter, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Parameter, values_from = value) %>%
    arrange(Iteration)
  
  mcmc(as.matrix(wide[,-1]))
})

mcmc_list_C1 <- as.mcmc.list(mcmc_list_C1)

```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: Chains convergence.
#| label: fig-IMDchainsconvergenceC1
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 8

  par(mfrow=c(1,3))

  gelman.plot(mcmc_list_C1,
            bin.width = 10,      # Number of observations per segment,
            # first segment --> at least 50 iterations.
            max.bins = 50,       # Maximum number of bins, excluding the last one
            confidence = 0.95,   # Coverage probability of confidence interval.
            transform = FALSE,   # improve the normality of the distribution
            autoburnin=TRUE)     # Remove first half of sequence

  
  gelman <- gelman.diag(mcmc_list_C1, confidence = 0.95, transform=FALSE, autoburnin=TRUE, multivariate=TRUE)
  print(gelman)
```

```{r corrC1, message=F, warning=F}
    mcmc(as.matrix(x)[-1, , drop = FALSE])  # <- reconvertir en mcmc
  })
)

colramp_aurora <- colorRampPalette(rev(Nord_aurora[1:4]))
ipairs(as.matrix(mcmc_list_corr), colramp = colramp_aurora, pixs=0.25, cex.diag = 0.5)
```

```{r IMDpostC1, message=F, warning=F}
#| fig-cap: Distributions of the priors and the posteriors.
#| label: fig-IMDpostC1
#| fig-height: 6

alpha_prior <- 0.5
alpha_post <- 0.5
col_prior <- Nord_snow[1]
col_post <- col_IMD

MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Chains_plot <- MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Chains |> 
  mutate(Nom = str_remove(Parameter, "\\.\\d+\\.$")) |> 
  filter(!(Nom == "kuIMD" & value > 10))

p_post <- ggplot() +
  
  # Priors
  stat_halfeye(
    data = df_priors_dist_C1,
    aes(
       x = samples,
       #y = ..scaled..
       ),
    alpha = alpha_prior,
    fill = col_prior,
    color = col_prior,
    normalize = "xy"
    ) +
  
  # Posterior
  stat_halfeye(
    data = subset(MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Chains_plot, Nom %in% L_parameters_C1),
    mapping = aes(
      x=value
    ),
    fill = col_post,
    color = col_post,
    alpha = alpha_post,
    normalize = "xy"
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~Nom, scales = "free")+
  labs(
    title = "Posterior and prior distributions", 
    x = "Parameter value", 
    y = "Density"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(
    title=element_markdown(face="bold")
  )
```

```{r calcBCFIMD, message=F, warning=F}

f_get_mode <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(x)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

####### C1 ##########################################################

MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Chains <- MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Chains |> 
  mutate(Nom = str_remove(Parameter, "\\.\\d+\\.$")) 

ku_samples_C1 <- MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Chains |> filter(Nom == "kuIMD")
ke_samples_C1 <- MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Chains |> filter(Nom == "keIMD")

BCF_samples_C1 <- ku_samples_C1$value / ke_samples_C1$value

BCF_mode_C1 <- f_get_mode(BCF_samples_C1)
BCF_CI_C1 <- quantile(BCF_samples_C1, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
BCF_CI_low_C1 <- as.numeric(BCF_CI_C1[1])
BCF_CI_up_C1 <- as.numeric(BCF_CI_C1[2])
BCF_min_C1 <- min(BCF_samples_C1)
BCF_max_C1 <- max(BCF_samples_C1)
BCF_mean_C1 <- mean(BCF_samples_C1)
BCF_sd_C1 <- sd(BCF_samples_C1)

BCF_C1 <- c(
  BCF_mode_C1, 
  BCF_CI_low_C1, BCF_CI_up_C1, 
  BCF_min_C1, BCF_max_C1, 
  BCF_mean_C1, BCF_sd_C1
  )
```

```{r IMDSummaryResC1, message=F, warning=F}
#| tbl-cap: Results summary
#| label: tbl-IMDressumC1

Summary_res_IMD_tmp_C1 <- cbind(as.data.frame(MCMC_out_IMD_C1$Summary_res)[1:length(L_parameters_C1)], BCF_C1)

Summary_res_IMD_f_C1 <- Summary_res_IMD_tmp_C1 |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), signif, 2))

Summary_res_IMD_f_C1 |> datatable(
  options = list(
    dom = 't',
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(
      list(className = 'dt-left', targets = "_all")
      )
    ),
  class="hover"
  )

# Summary_res_IMD_f

```

```{r bicC1}
# BIC calculation

LL_C1 <- f_get_mode(MCMC_out_IMD_C1$df_LnData$LnData)

n <- length(na.omit(df_TK_IMD$Weight)) + length(na.omit(df_TK_IMD$CiIMD))
k <- Nb_param_C1 -2

BIC_C1 <- -2*LL_C1 + k*log(n)

cat("Number of observations, n = ", n,"\nNumber of parameters, k = ", k, "\nLog-likelihood, LL = ", LL_C1, "\nBIC = ", BIC_C1)

```

```{r bicC1N}
LL_C1N <- f_get_mode(MCMC_out_IMD_C1N$df_LnData$LnData)

n <- length(na.omit(df_TK_IMD$Weight)) + length(na.omit(df_TK_IMD$CiIMD))
k <- Nb_param_C1N -2

BIC_C1N <- -2*LL_C1N + k*log(n)

cat("Number of observations, n = ", n,"\nNumber of parameters, k = ", k, "\nLog-likelihood, LL = ", LL_C1N, "\nBIC = ", BIC_C1N)

```

### Comparison of observed vs. predicted data

Creation of the `.in` files that will enable the obtention of the prediction of the model for all of our data points :

```{r setpointindin, message=F, warning=F}

######## C1 #########################################
l_param_name_C1 <- "kuIMD, keIMD, a_growth"
f_Setpoint_ind(path_mod_IMD_C1,Molecule, l_param_name_C1)

######## C1P #########################################
l_param_name_C1P <- "kuIMD, keIMD, phi, a_growth"
f_Setpoint_ind(path_mod_IMD_C1P,Molecule, l_param_name_C1P)

######## C1N #########################################
l_param_name_C1N <- "kuIMD, keIMD, a_growth"
f_Setpoint_ind(path_mod_IMD_C1N,Molecule, l_param_name_C1N)

######## C2 #########################################
l_param_name_C2 <- "kuIMD, keIMD, kperiph, a_growth"
f_Setpoint_ind(path_mod_IMD_C2,Molecule, l_param_name_C2)

######## C2P #########################################
l_param_name_C2P <- "kuIMD, keIMD, kperiph, phi, a_growth"
f_Setpoint_ind(path_mod_IMD_C2P,Molecule, l_param_name_C2P)

######## C2N #########################################
l_param_name_C2N <- "kuIMD, keIMD, kperiph, a_growth"
f_Setpoint_ind(path_mod_IMD_C2N,Molecule, l_param_name_C2N)
```

An example of how to run the simulations for the predicted-observed data is given in the bash code block below. You need to be in the right folder to launch a given model.

```{bash, eval=F, execute=F}
pwd
cd ..
cd ..
cd mod/TK_IMD
pwd

for j in $(seq 1 63); do
./mcsim.m_TK_IMD TK_IMD_Setpoint_ind_${j}.in
done
```

```{r IMDdataObs, message=F, warning=F}

Nb_experiment <- Nb_experiment_C1

######### Observed data ######################################################

dObs_ind <- df_TK_IMD |> 
  mutate(
    ID = as.numeric(ID),
    Group_tmp = case_when(
      ID < 65 ~ "Uptake",
      (ID > 64 & ID <= 128) ~ "Elimination",
      ID > 128 ~ "Uptake bis"),
    Group = fct_relevel(Group_tmp, c("Uptake", "Elimination", "Uptake bis"))
    )

colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "Weight"] <- "Weight_obs"
colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "CiIMD"] <- "CiIMD_obs"
colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "t"] <- "Times"

col_exposure <- c(Nord_aurora[4], Nord_aurora[1], Nord_frost[2])

############ C1 ##############################################################

Sim.Res.ind_C1 <- lapply(1:Nb_experiment, function(j) {
  read_tsv(file.path(path_mod_IMD_C1, paste0("Setpoints_ind_", j, ".out"))) %>%
    mutate(sim = j)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

df_mod_ind_C1 <- NULL

for (i in 1:Nb_experiment){
  
  ID_i <- unique(dObs_ind$ID)[i]

  Sim.Res.ind_i  <- subset(Sim.Res.ind_C1, sim == i) |> 
    dplyr::select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x))))
  
  dObs_i <- subset(dObs_ind, ID == ID_i)
  
  Time_pred = dObs_i$Time # !!!
  
  Nom_Endpoints = c("Weight", "CiIMD")
  
  Nsortie = 2
  
  MPV = IC_min = IC_max = Endpoint = index = NULL
  
  for (j in 1:length(Nom_Endpoints)){
    
    index =grep(paste0("^",Nom_Endpoints[j],"_") , colnames(Sim.Res.ind_i), fixed=FALSE)

    
    Data_sim = as.matrix( Sim.Res.ind_i[ , index] )
    
    MPV    = c(  MPV,  as.numeric( Data_sim[nrow(Data_sim), ] ) )
    IC_min = c(IC_min,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.025, na.rm=TRUE) )
    IC_max = c(IC_max,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.975, na.rm=TRUE) ) 
    
    Endpoint = c(Endpoint, rep(Nom_Endpoints[j], ncol(Data_sim)))
  }
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- data.frame(
    predict.endpoint = MPV,
    Time    = rep(Time_pred, Nsortie),
    low     = IC_min,
    up      = IC_max,
    Endpt   = Endpoint
    )
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- df_mod_ind_i %>%
    mutate(ID=ID_i)

  df_mod_ind_C1 <- rbind(df_mod_ind_C1, df_mod_ind_i)
}

df_mod_Weight_ind_C1 <- subset(df_mod_ind_C1, Endpt == "Weight" & Time !=0)
df_mod_CiIMD_ind_C1 <- subset(df_mod_ind_C1, Endpt == "CiIMD" & Time !=0)

df_predobs_CiIMD_ind_C1 <- dObs_ind |> 
  filter(Time !=0) |>
  left_join(df_mod_CiIMD_ind_C1, suffix = c("_obs", "_pred")) |> 
  dplyr::select(-c(Weight_obs, CiEPX)) |> 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace(.x, .x == -1, NA))) |> 
  drop_na()

df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1 <- dObs_ind |> 
  filter(Time !=0) |>
  left_join(df_mod_Weight_ind_C1, suffix = c("_obs", "_pred"))|>
  dplyr::select(-c(CiIMD_obs, CiEPX)) |> 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace(.x, .x == -1, NA))) |> 
  drop_na()

  dplyr::select(-c(CiIMD_obs, CiEPX)) |> 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace(.x, .x == -1, NA))) |> 
  drop_na()
```


```{r countfoldIMDC1, warning=F}

df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1 <- df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1 |>
  mutate(
    Ratio_predobs = predict.endpoint / Weight_obs,
    Residuals = predict.endpoint - Weight_obs
  )

Weight_count_fold2_C1 <- length(subset(df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1, Ratio_predobs >= 0.5 & Ratio_predobs <= 2)$Weight_obs) / length(df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1$Weight_obs) * 100

Weight_count_fold5_C1 <- length(subset(df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1, Ratio_predobs >= 0.2 & Ratio_predobs <= 5)$Weight_obs) / length(df_predobs_Weight_ind_C1$Weight_obs) * 100

df_predobs_CiIMD_ind_C1 <- df_predobs_CiIMD_ind_C1 |>
  mutate(
    Ratio_predobs = predict.endpoint / CiIMD_obs,
    Residuals = predict.endpoint - CiIMD_obs
  )

CiIMD_count_fold2_C1 <- length(subset(df_predobs_CiIMD_ind_C1, Ratio_predobs >= 0.5 & Ratio_predobs <= 2)$CiIMD_obs) / length(df_predobs_CiIMD_ind_C1$CiIMD_obs) * 100

CiIMD_count_fold5_C1 <- length(subset(df_predobs_CiIMD_ind_C1, Ratio_predobs >= 0.2 & Ratio_predobs <= 5)$CiIMD_obs) / length(df_predobs_CiIMD_ind_C1$CiIMD_obs) * 100

cat(
  "For weights : \n\n",
  "Percentage of prediction in fold 2 = ", round(Weight_count_fold2_C1, 1), "%\n",
  "Percentage of prediction in fold 5 = ", round(Weight_count_fold5_C1, 1), "%"
)
cat(
  "\n\nFor internal concentrations : \n\n",
  "Percentage of prediction in fold 2 = ", round(CiIMD_count_fold2_C1, 1), "%\n",
  "Percentage of prediction in fold 5 = ", round(CiIMD_count_fold5_C1, 1), "%"
)
```

```{r, message=F, warning=FALSE}
#| fig-cap: Residuals
#| label: fig-IMDresidualsC1
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 8

df_residuals_CiIMD_C1 <- df_predobs_CiIMD_ind_C1 |> 
  mutate(
    Residual = predict.endpoint - CiIMD_obs,
    Ratio_Residual = predict.endpoint/CiIMD_obs
    ) |> 
  mutate(
    Time_point = as.numeric(gsub("([0-9]+).*", "\\1" , as.character(Time_point_f))),
    Group = factor(Group, c("Uptake", "Elimination", "Uptake bis")),
    Time_relative = case_when(
      Group == "Uptake" ~ Time_point,
      Group == "Uptake bis" ~ Time_point,
      Group == "Elimination" ~ Time_point - 21
    )
    )

      y = Ratio_Residual,
      color = Group
    ),
    alpha=0.7
  )+
  labs(
    x = "Time point (days)",
    y = "Predicted/observed ratio"
  )+
  scale_color_manual(
    values = col_exposure_bis
    )+
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = unique(df_residuals_CiIMD_C1$Time_point)
  )+
  scale_y_log10()+
  theme_minimal()
```

:::

### Full individual trajectories

Creation of the `.in` files that will enable the obtention of the prediction of the full $C_i^{EPX}$ trajectories for each individual :

```{r setpointindfullin, message=F, warning=F}
Time_min <- 0

Time_max <- 44
Time_step <- 0.25
Time_pred <- seq(Time_min, Time_max, Time_step)
print_times <- paste(Time_min, Time_max, Time_step, sep=", ")
Molecule <- "IMD"


f_Setpoint_ind_full(path_mod_IMD_C1, Molecule, print_times, l_param_name_C1)
f_Setpoint_ind_full(path_mod_IMD_C1P, Molecule, print_times, l_param_name_C1P)
f_Setpoint_ind_full(path_mod_IMD_C1N, Molecule, print_times, l_param_name_C1N)
f_Setpoint_ind_full(path_mod_IMD_C2, Molecule, print_times, l_param_name_C2)
f_Setpoint_ind_full(path_mod_IMD_C2P, Molecule, print_times, l_param_name_C2P)
f_Setpoint_ind_full(path_mod_IMD_C2N, Molecule, print_times, l_param_name_C2N)

dObs_ind <- df_TK_IMD |> 
  mutate(ID = as.numeric(ID))
colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "Weight"] <- "Weight_obs"
colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "CiIMD"] <- "CiIMD_obs"
colnames(dObs_ind)[colnames(dObs_ind) == "t"] <- "Times"

time_limits <- dObs_ind %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(time_cutoff = max(Time, na.rm = TRUE) + 5)

Time_points_Nb_rep <- dObs_ind |> 
  dplyr::select(ID, Time_point_f, Nb_rep)

y_segment <- 2000

df_phases <- dObs_ind |>
  arrange(ID, Time) |>
  group_by(ID) |>
  mutate(
    row = row_number(),
    t_start = Time,
    t_end = lead(Time),  
    segment = row,
    y = y_segment
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(t_end)) |>  
  dplyr::select(ID, segment, t_start, t_end, y, Experiment) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(
    Phase = case_when(
      (segment == 1 & ID < 65) ~ 1,
      (segment == 2 & ID < 65) ~ 3,
      (segment == 1 & ID > 64) ~ 1,
      (segment == 2 & ID > 64) ~ 2,
      (segment == 3 & ID > 64) ~ 3,
      (Experiment == "TKBIS" & segment == 1)~1,
      (Experiment == "TKBIS" & segment == 2)~3
    )
  )
```

An example of how to run the simulations for the individual trajectories is given in the bash code block below. You need to be in the right folder to launch a given model.

```{bash, results=F, eval=F}
pwd
cd ..
cd ..
cd mod/TK_IMD
pwd

for j in $(seq 1 63); do
./mcsim.m_TK_IMD TK_IMD_Setpoint_ind_full_${j}.in
done

```

```{r IMDdatapredfull, message=F, warning=F}
##| cache: false

#nb_rows_ind <- NC*N_iter_setpoint+1

############### C1 ###################################################
Sim.Res.ind.full_C1 <- lapply(1:Nb_experiment, function(j) {
  read_tsv(file.path(path_mod_IMD_C1, paste0("Setpoints_ind_full_", j, ".out"))) %>%
    mutate(sim = j)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

df_mod_ind_C1 <- NULL

for (i in 1:Nb_experiment){

  
  ID_i <- unique(dObs_ind$ID)[i]

  Sim.Res.ind.full_i  <- subset(Sim.Res.ind.full_C1, sim == i) |> 
    dplyr::select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x))))
  
  dObs_i <- subset(dObs_ind, ID == ID_i)
  
  Nom_Endpoints = c("Weight", "CiIMD", "C_exposure")
  
  Nsortie = length(Nom_Endpoints)
  
  MPV = IC_min = IC_max = Endpoint = index = NULL
  
  for (j in 1:length(Nom_Endpoints)){
    
    index =grep(paste0("^",Nom_Endpoints[j],"_") , colnames(Sim.Res.ind.full_i), fixed=FALSE)

    
    Data_sim = as.matrix( Sim.Res.ind.full_i[ , index] )
    
    MPV    = c(  MPV,  as.numeric( Data_sim[nrow(Data_sim), ] ) )
    IC_min = c(IC_min,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.025, na.rm=TRUE) )
    IC_max = c(IC_max,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.975, na.rm=TRUE) ) 
    
    Endpoint = c(Endpoint, rep(Nom_Endpoints[j], ncol(Data_sim)))
  }
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- data.frame(
    predict.endpoint = MPV,
    Time    = rep(Time_pred, Nsortie),
    low     = IC_min,
    up      = IC_max,
    Endpt   = Endpoint
    )
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- df_mod_ind_i %>%
    mutate(ID=ID_i)

  df_mod_ind_C1 <- rbind(df_mod_ind_C1, df_mod_ind_i)
}

df_mod_Weight_ind_C1<- subset(df_mod_ind_C1, Endpt == "Weight")
df_mod_CiIMD_ind_C1 <- subset(df_mod_ind_C1, Endpt == "CiIMD")
df_mod_CeIMD_ind_C1 <- subset(df_mod_ind_C1, Endpt == "C_exposure")

df_mod_CiIMD_ind_t_C1 <- df_mod_CiIMD_ind_C1 %>%
  left_join(time_limits, by = "ID") %>%
  filter(Time <= time_cutoff) %>%
  dplyr::select(-time_cutoff) |> 
  left_join(Time_points_Nb_rep, by="ID")

df_mod_Weight_ind_t_C1 <- df_mod_Weight_ind_C1 %>%
  left_join(time_limits, by = "ID") %>%
  filter(Time <= time_cutoff) %>%
  dplyr::select(-time_cutoff) |> 
  left_join(Time_points_Nb_rep, by="ID")

df_mod_CeIMD_ind_t_C1 <- df_mod_CeIMD_ind_C1 %>%
  left_join(time_limits, by = "ID") %>%
  filter(Time <= time_cutoff) %>%
  dplyr::select(-time_cutoff) |> 
  left_join(Time_points_Nb_rep, by="ID")

    predict.endpoint = MPV,
    Time    = rep(Time_pred, Nsortie),
    low     = IC_min,
    up      = IC_max,
    Endpt   = Endpoint
    )
  
  df_mod_ind_i <- df_mod_ind_i %>%
    mutate(ID=ID_i)

  df_mod_ind_C2 <- rbind(df_mod_ind_C2, df_mod_ind_i)
}

    Endpoint = c(Endpoint, rep(Nom_Endpoints[j], ncol(Data_sim)))

    predict.endpoint = MPV,

    low     = IC_min,

}
```

```{r IMDpredcurvesdataC1, message=F, warning=F}
alpha_point <- 0.5

p_CiIMD_traj <- ggplot()+
  
  geom_segment(
    data = df_phases_plot,
    aes(
      x = t_start,
      xend = t_end,
      y = y,
      yend = y,
      group = ID,
      color = factor(Phase)
    ),
    linewidth = 2,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +

  geom_line(
    data=df_mod_CiIMD_ind_t_plot_C1,
    aes(
      x=Time,
      y= low,
      group = ID
      ),
    linetype="dotted",
    color = col_IMD
    )+
  geom_line(
    data=df_mod_CiIMD_ind_t_plot_C1,
    aes(
      x=Time,
      y= up,
      group = ID
      ),
    linetype="dotted",
    color = col_IMD
    )+
  geom_line(
    data=df_mod_CiIMD_ind_t_plot_C1,
    aes(
      x=Time,
      y= predict.endpoint,
      group = ID
      ),
    color = col_IMD,
    lwd=1
    )+
  geom_ribbon(
    data=df_mod_CiIMD_ind_t_plot_C1,
    aes(
      x=Time,
      ymax= up,
      ymin= low,
      group = ID
      ),
    fill = col_IMD,
    alpha=0.1
    )+
  geom_point(
    data = dObs_ind_plot,
    aes(
      x = Time,
      y = CiIMD_obs
    ),
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.7,
    color = col_red
  )+
  # facet_wrap(
  #   ~ID,
  #   ncol=4,
  #   #scales = "free_x"
  #   )+
  facet_grid(
    vars(Time_point_days), vars(No_rep)#,
    )+
  scale_color_manual(
    values = col_exposure,
    label = c("Uptake", "Elimination", "Depuration"),
    name = "Phase"
    )+
  labs(
    x = "Time (days)",
    y = "CiIMD (ng/g)"
  )+
  #lims(y=c(0, 300))+
  theme_minimal()
```

### Simulation of the toxicodynamic in earthworms throughout the exposition

The goal here is to recreate the concentration dynamic in the average earthworm during our exposition scheme but without the fasting phase that was required for chemical analysis and during which elimination was happening.

```{r setpointin, message=F, warning=F}

Time_min <- 0
Time_max <- 42
Time_step <- 0.25
Time_pred <- seq(Time_min, Time_max, Time_step)
print_times <- paste(Time_min, Time_max, Time_step, sep=", ")

l_param_name_tot_C1 <- "kuIMD, keIMD, a_growth, Vr_a_growth, Sigma_W, Sigma_CiIMD"
f_Setpoint(path_mod_IMD_C1, Molecule, print_times, l_param_name_tot_C1)

l_param_name_tot_C1P <- "kuIMD, keIMD, a_growth, phi, Vr_a_growth, Sigma_W, Sigma_CiIMD"
f_Setpoint(path_mod_IMD_C1P, Molecule, print_times, l_param_name_tot_C1P)

l_param_name_tot_C1N <- "kuIMD, keIMD, a_growth, Vr_a_growth, Sigma_W, Sigma_CiIMD"
f_Setpoint(path_mod_IMD_C1N, Molecule, print_times, l_param_name_tot_C1N)

l_param_name_tot_C2 <- "kuIMD, keIMD, kperiph, a_growth, Vr_a_growth, Sigma_W, Sigma_CiIMD"
```

```{r IMDreadSetpoint, message=F, warning=F}

############ C1 ##################################

Sim.Res_C1 <- as.data.frame(fread(here::here(path_mod_IMD_C1, "Setpoints.out"),sep="\t"))

  
  Nom_Endpoints =c("Weight_1", "CiIMD_1", "C_exposure_1")
  Nsortie = 3
  MPV = IC_min = IC_max = Endpoint = index = NULL

  for (i in 1:length(Nom_Endpoints)){
    
    index =grep(paste("^",Nom_Endpoints[i],"\\.", sep="") , colnames(Sim.Res_C1), fixed=FALSE )
    
    Data_sim = as.matrix( Sim.Res_C1[ , index] )
    
    MPV    = c(  MPV,  as.numeric( Data_sim[nrow(Data_sim), ] ) )
    IC_min = c(IC_min,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.025) )
    IC_max = c(IC_max,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.975) ) 
    
    Endpoint = c(Endpoint, rep(Nom_Endpoints[i], ncol(Data_sim)))

    }

  df_mod_C1 <- data.frame(
    predict.endpoint = MPV,
    Time    = c( rep(Time_pred, Nsortie)),
    low     = IC_min,
    up      = IC_max,
    Endpt   = Endpoint,
    Experiment = c(rep(rep("Experience 1", length(Time_pred)), Nsortie))
    )
  
df_mod_Weight_C1 <- subset(df_mod_C1, Endpt == "Weight_1")
df_mod_CiIMD_C1 <- subset(df_mod_C1, Endpt == "CiIMD_1")

    IC_max = c(IC_max,  apply(Data_sim, 2, quantile,  0.975) ) 
    
    Endpoint = c(Endpoint, rep(Nom_Endpoints[i], ncol(Data_sim)))

    }

  df_mod_C2N <- data.frame(
    predict.endpoint = MPV,
    Time    = c( rep(Time_pred, Nsortie)),
    low     = IC_min,
    up      = IC_max,
    Endpt   = Endpoint,
    Experiment = c(rep(rep("Experience 1", length(Time_pred)), Nsortie))
    )
  
df_mod_Weight_C2N <- subset(df_mod_C2N, Endpt == "Weight_1")
df_mod_CiIMD_C2N <- subset(df_mod_C2N, Endpt == "CiIMD_1") 


  # length(MPV)
  # length(df_Cin$Time)
  # length(Endpoint)
  # length(df_Cin$Experiment)
```

## Summary

```{r, message=F, warning=F}
#| tbl-cap: "Estimated toxicokinetic parameters for single exposure of *Aporrectodea caliginosa* to imidacloprid with the use of TK data only  (without TK BIS). Results are expressed as the modes of the distributions and their respective credibility interval (95%). C1 : One compartment model, C1P : One compartment model with exposure through gut route in Petri dishes, C2 : Two-compartment model, C2P : Two-compartment model with exposure through gut route in Petri dishes, C2N : Two-compartment model with omission of the depuration phase in Petri dishes."
#| label: tbl-IMDressumall

format_summary <- function(summary_df, model_name) {
  
  summary_df %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rename(BCF = last_col()) |> 
    rownames_to_column("stat") %>%
    filter(stat %in% c("Result_mode", "2.5%", "97.5%")) %>%
    
    pivot_longer(-stat, names_to = "param", values_to = "value") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) %>%
    
    mutate(
      value = sprintf("%.3g [%.3g ; %.3g]", Result_mode, `2.5%`, `97.5%`),
      model = model_name
    ) %>%
    
    dplyr::select(model, param, value)
}

res_C1   <- format_summary(Summary_res_IMD_f_C1, "C1")
res_C1P  <- format_summary(Summary_res_IMD_f_C1P, "C1P")
res_C1N  <- format_summary(Summary_res_IMD_f_C1N, "C1N")
res_C2   <- format_summary(Summary_res_IMD_f_C2, "C2")
res_C2P  <- format_summary(Summary_res_IMD_f_C2P, "C2P")
res_C2N  <- format_summary(Summary_res_IMD_f_C2N, "C2N")

all_res <- bind_rows(res_C1, res_C1P, res_C1N,
                     res_C2, res_C2P, res_C2N)


round_fold <- 1

extra_metrics <- tibble(
  model = c("C1","C1P","C1N","C2","C2P","C2N"),
  LL   = c(round(LL_C1, round_fold), round(LL_C1P, round_fold), round(LL_C1N, round_fold), round(LL_C2, round_fold), round(LL_C2P, round_fold), round(LL_C2N, round_fold)),
  BIC  = c(round(BIC_C1, round_fold), round(BIC_C1P, round_fold), round(BIC_C1N, round_fold), round(BIC_C2, round_fold), round(BIC_C2P, round_fold), round(BIC_C2N, round_fold)),
  fold2 = c(round(CiIMD_count_fold2_C1, round_fold), round(CiIMD_count_fold2_C1P, round_fold), round(CiIMD_count_fold2_C1N, round_fold),
            round(CiIMD_count_fold2_C2, round_fold), round(CiIMD_count_fold2_C2P, round_fold), round(CiIMD_count_fold2_C2N, round_fold)),
  fold5 = c(round(CiIMD_count_fold5_C1, round_fold), round(CiIMD_count_fold5_C1P, round_fold), round(CiIMD_count_fold5_C1N, round_fold),
            round(CiIMD_count_fold5_C2, round_fold), round(CiIMD_count_fold5_C2P, round_fold), round(CiIMD_count_fold5_C2N, round_fold))
)

final_table <- all_res %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = param, values_from = value) %>%
  rename_with(~ sub("\\.1\\.$", "", .)) |> 
  relocate(BCF, .after = last_col()) |> 
  left_join(extra_metrics, by = "model") %>%
  dplyr::select(model, everything())

final_table %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = model
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = -model
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(12),
    data_row.padding = px(4)
  )

```
